text: spm_fit object containing estimated model parameters.

title: Fitting an underlying continuous process to areal data — fit_spm
text: function utilizes optimization algorithms stats::optim determine Maximum Likelihood estimators (MLEs) standard errors model adapted areal data. Users can customize optimization process providing control parameters control_opt argument (named list, see stats::optim details), specifying lower upper bounds parameters, selecting desired optimization algorithm via opt_method (must available stats::optim). Additionally, function supports various covariance functions, including Matern, Exponential, Powered Exponential, Gaussian, Spherical. apply_exp argument, logical scalar, allows exponentiation non-negative parameters, enabling optimization entire real line. underlying model assumes point-level process: $$Y(\mathbf{s}) = \mu + S(\mathbf{s})$$ \(S ~ GP(0, \sigma^2 C(\lVert \mathbf{s} - \mathbf{s}_2 \rVert; \theta))\). observed areal data assumed behave average process area: $$Y(B) = \lvert B \rvert^{-1} \int_{B} Y(\mathbf{s}) \, \textrm{d} \mathbf{s}$$.

text: range_nu numeric vector length 2, specifying minimum maximum values power parameter nu. nu typically ranges 0 2 (e.g., nu = 1 exponential, nu = 2 Gaussian). range_rho numeric vector length 2, specifying minimum maximum values practical range parameter rho. rho must positive. grid_len integer specifying number points create nu rho sequences. total number grid combinations grid_len^2. title: Calculate Smallest Eigenvalue for Power Exponential Correlation Matrices — sev_pexp
text: tibble three columns: rho practical range parameter value. nu power parameter value. lambda smallest eigenvalue power exponential correlation matrix corresponding rho nu pair.

title: Calculate Smallest Eigenvalue for Power Exponential Correlation Matrices — sev_pexp
text: practical range rho defined distance correlation 0.1. internal scale parameter phi calculated phi = rho / (log(10)^(1/nu)). power exponential correlation function assumed form C(h) = exp(-(h/phi)^nu), h distance.  function smile:::pexp_cov used internally compute covariance/correlation matrix sill 1. function first creates grid nu rho parameters. pair (rho, nu) grid: 1. calculates scale parameter phi power exponential correlation function, phi = rho / (log(10)^(1/nu)). definition implies correlation 0.1 distance rho.  2. computes power exponential correlation matrix using smile:::pexp_cov(dists = dmat, sill = 1, range = phi, smooth = nu).  Note use internal function smile package.  3. calculates eigenvalues correlation matrix. 4. minimum eigenvalue extracted.  final output tibble containing parameter combinations corresponding minimum eigenvalues.
